description: The previous Iranian passport must be submitted with the application. If lost or stolen, a police report or notarised statement is required instead.
Six to fourteen weeks with no passport means no international travel, no flight booking, and in many countries no accepted primary identity document.
time_note: A window in which you cannot leave or prove who you are.
energy_note: Grounded by paperwork, not by law.

aspect: EXAMPLE - it collides with residence permits
description: Many residence permits are physically endorsed in, or linked to, the passport. A renewal that overlaps a permit renewal, a job start date or a re-entry can unpick a lawful status that took years to obtain.
money_note: Legal advice, missed start dates, emergency travel documents.

aspect: EXAMPLE - and a family cannot stagger it
description: A family renewing together either sends all passports at once and freezes everyone, or staggers them across six months and freezes someone continuously.
energy_note: No arrangement in which everyone can travel.

aspect: SCENARIO - the fourteen weeks with no passport
description: Omid posts his Iranian passport to Washington in February for renewal. His Canadian work permit renewal is due in April and requires a valid passport. He discovers this in March. The Interests Section cannot expedite and cannot return the document mid-process.
energy_note: Two deadlines, one document, no way to be in both places.
